en: Colorized panoramic view over a town nestled among low, wooded hills. The foreground shows several villas and houses with red and dark roofs, gardens, and tree‑lined streets. The settlement extends into the valley, surrounded by green hills under a pale blue sky. At the top of the card there is printed text reading the town name and a caption indicating a general view.
